english.title: Use a motor vehicle on a road when the load / passengers likely to cause danger
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a

(A)_[motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[trailer drawn by a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..),]_

(C)_[the number of passengers being carried by it being such]_
(D)_[the manner in which passengers were being carried on it being such]_
(E)_[the weight, distribution, packing or adjustment of its load being such]_

that danger was caused or was likely to be caused to any person in or on it or on a road
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 100(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
use on a road a motor vehicle/trailer
the number of/manner in which passenger carried OR
weight/distribution/packing/adjustment of the load
was such to caused/likely to be cause danger

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) OFFICERS SHOULD BE AWARE that this is a non-endorsable offence - a comparable endorsable offence exists under section 40A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 which should be used wherever possible.
(ii) See also offence wordings H3100, H3101, H6569 and H6575 - for using vehicle where there is danger of injury due to the vehicle accessories/equipment, load/passengers or condition.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). Danger was

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[likely to be caused]_

to a person in or on

(C)_[the vehicle]_
(D)_[a trailer drawn by the vehicle]_

or on a road because of **(..SPECIFY THE CAUSE OF THE DANGER..).

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Defnyddio cerbyd modur ar ffordd pan oedd y llwyth / teithwyr yn debygol o achosi perygl
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) bu ichi ddefnyddio ar ffordd, sef **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a

(A)_[gerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]._
(B)_[trelar a oedd yn cael ei dynnu gan gerbyd, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..),]._

(D)_[Roedd y ffordd yr oedd teithwyr yn cael eu cludo arno yn golygu bod]_

perygl wedi cael ei achosi neu'n debygol o gael ei achosi i unrhyw unigolyn ynddo neu arno neu ar y ffordd

Am **(..SPECIFY TIME..) ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) bu i'r diffynnydd ddefnyddio **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ar **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..).

(A)_[Achoswyd perygl]_
(B)_[Roedd perygl yn debygol o gael ei achosi]_

i unigolyn yn neu ar

(C)_[y cerbyd]_
(D)_[trelar a oedd yn cael ei dynnu gan y cerbyd]_

neu ar y ffordd oherwydd **(..SPECIFY THE CAUSE OF THE DANGER..).
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i reoliad 100(1) Rheoliadau Cerbydau Ffyrdd (Gwneuthuriad a Defnydd) 1986, adran 42 Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988 ac Atodlen 2 Deddf Troseddwyr Traffig Ffyrdd 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - One hundred pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level four on the legislative standard scale
